name: colab-runner
description: Run isolated jobs or reusable leased sessions on Google Colab through the official CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Colab jobs and leased sessions from Codex
interface.longDescription: Run isolated workloads or reuse a leased Google Colab kernel through the official CLI, execute selected notebook cells, retrieve declared artifacts, export replayable logs, and automatically release idle sessions.
defaultPrompt: Run this Python workload safely on Colab and retrieve its artifacts.
Keep a Colab kernel alive while I execute selected notebook cells.
Check my active Colab sessions and report anything still consuming compute.
Execute this notebook on a T4 with a hard deadline and export the run log.
